name: ZapCache
author: Aleksandr Ivanov

sections.description:
ZapCache is a powerful WordPress plugin that instantly clears various types of caches with a single click to improve site performance and resolve cache-related issues.

Detailed Description

Lightning-Fast Cache Clearing: Experience blazing-fast cache clearing that works in milliseconds, not minutes. ZapCache is designed for speed and efficiency, ensuring your WordPress site stays optimized without any delays.

One-Click Wonder: No more navigating through multiple menus or remembering complex cache clearing procedures. With ZapCache, everything happens with just one click – it’s that simple and powerful.

Professional-Grade Performance: Built with performance in mind, ZapCache handles all major caching systems seamlessly while maintaining the highest standards of reliability and safety.

Supported Caching Plugins:
* WordPress Object Cache
* WordPress Transients
* WP Super Cache
* W3 Total Cache
* LiteSpeed Cache
* Autoptimize
* WP Fastest Cache
* SG Optimizer
* WP Rocket

Key Features:
* Lightning-fast performance – Cache clearing in milliseconds
* Universal compatibility – Works with all major caching plugins
* One-click simplicity – No complex procedures or menus
* Enterprise-grade security – Safe clearing without data loss
* Global accessibility – 23+ languages with professional translations
* Zero configuration – Works out of the box
* Performance optimized – Built for modern WordPress sites

Supported Languages: 23+ languages with full interface localization.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/zapcache or install via admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin in Plugins screen.
  3. Open Tools → ZapCache.
  4. Click Clear WordPress Cache.
sections.faq:
Does it work with my caching plugin?

Yes. Popular plugins are supported; internal caches and transients are cleared anyway.

Is it safe to use?

Yes. The plugin only removes cache data and doesn’t touch content or settings.

How do translations work?

Translations are built-in. Uses the site language from Settings → General → Site Language.

Do I need to install language files?

No. All translations are built into the plugin without the need for additional setup or external files.

What languages are supported?

The plugin supports 23+ languages with full interface localization. It automatically detects WordPress language settings.

What if cache doesn’t clear?

Make sure you have administrator rights. If the problem persists, try deactivating and reactivating the plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.5.0

  • MAJOR UPDATE: Enhanced Object Cache detection and clearing
  • NEW: Improved Object Cache size calculation with better accuracy
  • NEW: Enhanced cache clearing methods with multiple fallback options
  • NEW: Better detection of WordPress default object cache usage
  • IMPROVED: More reliable Object Cache clearing across different configurations
  • IMPROVED: Enhanced compatibility with various WordPress setups
  • IMPROVED: Cleaner codebase with optimized performance
  • FIXED: Object Cache size reporting issues
  • FIXED: Improved cache clearing reliability for edge cases
  • NOTE: WordPress Object Cache by default is NOT persistent – data is only saved within a single HTTP request. This is normal behavior for WordPress without external cache plugins.

1.4.0

  • MAJOR UPDATE: Improved cache clearing accuracy
  • NEW: Shows actual amount of cache cleared (before vs after measurement)
  • NEW: Displays zero when cache is already empty
  • NEW: Individual size reporting for each cache type
  • NEW: Better compatibility with different plugin versions
  • NEW: Multilingual support for all reports across 23+ languages
  • IMPROVED: Enhanced cache clearing functions with fallback methods
  • IMPROVED: More reliable cache size calculations

1.3.1

  • IMPROVED: Enhanced stability and performance
  • FIXED: Minor compatibility issues

1.3

  • MAJOR UPDATE: Extended multilingual support to 23+ languages
  • NEW: Added support for Armenian, Georgian, Kyrgyz, Tajik, Uzbek, Abkhaz, and Ossetian languages
  • NEW: Professional translations for Caucasus and Central Asian regions
  • IMPROVED: Enhanced global accessibility for diverse language communities

1.2

  • NEW: Full multilingual support (11+ languages)
  • NEW: Built-in translations for all supported languages
  • IMPROVED: Enhanced cache clearing for popular plugins
  • FIXED: Compatibility issues with WordPress 6.0+

1.1

  • NEW: Added support for additional cache plugins
  • IMPROVED: Enhanced compatibility with WordPress 6.0+
  • FIXED: Minor compatibility issues

1.0

  • NEW: Initial release
  • NEW: Basic cache clearing functionality
  • NEW: Support for WordPress Object Cache and Transients
